text:
rachel: Heads-up: onboarding sampleapp showed duplicate side-effects when a 429 coincided with token rotation during a stream resume. Minimal repro below.

rachel: Repro steps: 1) start streaming POST /v1/chat, 2) token expires mid-stream, 3) next chunk gets 429, 4) SDK refreshes token and immediately retransmits same chunk envelope, 5) server processes both -> duplicate.

tom: do we have request ids that match both processed entries? saw two success entries with same business-id in the logs.

rachel: pasted sanitized trace:
```
[2026-04-02T09:12:01Z] biz_id=evt-42 status=202 chunk=1
[2026-04-02T09:13:30Z] biz_id=evt-42 status=429 note="auth-refresh"
[2026-04-02T09:13:31Z] client: token-refresh start
[2026-04-02T09:13:31Z] client: retry chunk with new token biz_id=evt-42
[2026-04-02T09:13:33Z] biz_id=evt-42 status=200 processed
```

vik: sounds like two actionable gaps: (1) SDK refresh-path does immediate retry (no jitter) and (2) streaming retries don't preserve a stable operation id.

vik: propose quick mitigation for sampleapp: attach a stable header on stream start `X-Redwood-Op-Id: <uuid>` and include that op id in retried frames. Server can dedupe by op id for a short TTL.

tom: also add default `Idempotency-Key` header on mutating calls in SDKs (opt-out) so non-streaming sample code gets safer defaults. Parity note: ensure node/python/java SDKs all enable this opt-out-by-config.

vik: jitter proposal for refresh retries: base=200ms; sleep = Math.random() * Math.min(base * 2**attempt, 10000) // full jitter; cap 10s. avoids thundering immediate replays after refresh.

rachel: server-side cheap change: keep seen op ids in bounded cache for 60s and return 409 or `X-RW-Dedupe-Result: duplicate` when dup detected. We'll document TTL and allow clients to request longer window via `Idempotency-Expiry` header (server clamps to max).

tom: sampleapp patch snippet (node):
```
const opId = uuidv4();
fetch('/v1/streams/chat', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: {
    'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}`,
    'X-Redwood-Op-Id': opId
  }
});
// when re-sending a chunk after refresh, include opId in the envelope
```

vik: opened RW-7007: "SDK: refresh-path full jitter + idempotency defaults + streaming op-id" assigned to @tom. CI will run cross-language parity tests.

ci-bot: RW-7007 queued for canary. Note: tests must include deterministic harness that forces mid-stream token expiry and asserts at-most-once server action.

rachel: action items: tom - SDK PR for jitter + idempotency defaults, vik - sampleapp patch adding Op-Id + test harness, i'll update onboarding guide to mention Op-Id and Idempotency-Expiry. If possible add an opt-in response header `X-RW-Dedupe-Result: accepted|duplicate|expired` to help debugging.

tom: will send PR today and add unit + interop tests. thanks.
